errors.text: The proposed optimum of 925 °C directly conflicts with the target optimum of 1000 °C.

The hypothesis treats oxide or secondary-phase precipitation as something to suppress, whereas the target mechanism depends on uniformly distributed AlV2O4, FeAl2O4, and FeTiO3 barrier phases formed at 1000 °C.
The specified alloy systems do not reconstruct the MgAlTiVFeCo ball-milled BCC starting material.
The claimed Mg-volatility threshold above 950–975 °C and the predicted >98.5% density are unsupported by the cited evidence, which concerns chemically dissimilar refractory or Co-rich alloys.
The falsification experiment omits the decisive 1000 °C condition and oxidation testing at 900 °C, so it cannot test the target optimum or its biphasic parabolic oxidation mechanism.
